notablePrerequisites:
Sand Squid and Warchanter Skald do not have summoning sickness.
Warchanter Skald has at least one Aura and/or Equipment attached.
description:
Activate Sand Squid by tapping it, tapping Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker creature token.
When the Dwarf Berserker enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
